headline: Mamdani unveils plan to close Rikers Island by 2032
pages: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani on Friday unveiled a plan to close the Rikers Island jail complex by 2032, build four new jails and sharply cut the city's detainee population. The city council first voted in 2019 to close Rikers by this year, but the effort stalled, partly over where to house inmates. Rikers sits on a 413 acre island between Queens and the Bronx and holds more than 6,500 people at a time. Mamdani wants that number down to 4,100. The city's close Rikers official, Dana Kaplan, called it a chance to build a different kind of detention system.

The correction officers' union objected, calling a cap on jail beds ill-conceived and warning it could force the release of people charged with violent felonies. Kaplan said it is possible to have fewer people in jail. The plan matters because Rikers has long been criticized for staffing shortages and decrepit conditions. Source: BBC.
